{{Quote|Our guards at the Sith fortress were set upon early this morning.|Jedi Master [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]], on the attack in which Vorlocca was killed|<ref name="AMA" />}}
'''Vorlocca''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], where they helped guard the [[Almas Sith fortress]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Vorlocca and five other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were [[Raid on the Almas Sith fortress|attacked]] by the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] [[Phylus Mon]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Karae Nalvas]], and several of Mon's minions, who planned to enter the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] to search for the secrets of the creation of [[Sith battlelord]]s. Vorlocca was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fight, and the attackers subsequently dragged the Wookiee's corpse inside the fortress, [[Diet/Legends|feeding]] it to three [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]]. A [[Heroes of Cularin|search team]] that had traveled to the fortress to look for any Jedi who had survived the attack later discovered Vorlocca's body.

==Biography==
Vorlocca was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who served as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. At some point, they became a member of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] force that was [[Garrison/Legends|garrisoned]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] outside the [[Almas Sith fortress]] to keep the [[Believers]],<ref name="AMA" /> a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="CA">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away}}</ref> from entering the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]],<ref name="AMA" /> which had previously served as a Believer base.<ref name="ADF">{{LivingForce|Almas, Sweet Almas: A Dark Fortress}}</ref> While most of the fortress's Jedi guards were stationed north of the building, Vorlocca was one of six Jedi assigned to protect the facility's south entrance.<ref name="AMA" />

[[File:Almas.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vorlocca was killed on Almas alongside several other Jedi guards.]]
During a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]]<ref name="AMA" /> around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY" /> the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] [[Phylus Mon]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Karae Nalvas]], and a number of Mon's minions traveled to the south entrance to access the fortress, where they planned to search for the secrets of the creation of ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] known as [[Sith battlelord]]s. Mon's forces [[Raid on the Almas Sith fortress|attacked]] Vorlocca and the other five Jedi guards; during the ensuing fight, Vorlocca and the Jedi [[Tresten Agai'i]], [[K'kur]], and [[Milak Sonloam]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]], while the other two Jedi defenders were captured, allowing Mon and Nalvas to enter the fortress. The attackers dragged Vorlocca's body inside the building and abandoned it in an enslavement pen in the lower levels of the fortress to be [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by three [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]] that Mon had brought with him into the facility.<ref name="AMA" />

In the aftermath of the attack, the Jedi discovered the bodies of Agaai'i, K'kur, and Sonloam, and they dispatched a number of search parties into the fortress to try and find Vorlocca and the two captured Jedi. Two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after Vorlocca's death, one [[Heroes of Cularin|search team]] made its way to the lower levels of the fortress, where it located the Wookiee's corpse and observed as one of the gundarks shredded the Wookiee's body and fed from it.<ref name="AMA" />

==Powers and abilities==
Vorlocca was a very skilled Jedi Knight who could have qualified as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] if they had desired to do so. The Wookiee was chosen to guard the south entrance of the Sith fortress because of their exceptional abilities, as the Jedi knew less about the south entrance than they did about the building's other entrances. Vorlocca was more physically powerful than their fellow guards Tresten Agai'i, K'kur, and Milak Sonloam.<ref name="AMA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|An empty vessel? Unlikely.|Darsin, if the player characters ask him whether Vorlocca's body had been separated from its Force essence|<ref name="AMA" />}}
Vorlocca was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and was featured in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[A Mon Alone]]'', a supplement that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. In the adventure, the player characters, who [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the search party that discovers Vorlocca's corpse, find a number of individuals inside the Sith fortress who have had their [[The Force/Legends|Force]] essences separated from their bodies as a result of Phylus Mon's attempts to carry out a ritual relating to the creation of Sith battlelords. It is then possible for the players to ask the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] [[Darsin]] if Vorlocca's body had also been separated from its Force essence, to which the spirit replies is unlikely. It is also possible for the player characters to take Vorlocca's body with them when they leave the fortress. If they choose to do so, the cadaver is then loaded onto a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with the player characters and is taken to the [[Almas Academy]], a [[Jedi academy]] that was located on Almas.<ref name="AMA" />
